## Acknowledgements
- [ ] I understand that contributing does not require membership, and membership is voluntary.
- [ ] I have read and agree to follow the [code of conduct](https://github.com/Intelligenza-Umana/intelligenza-umana/blob/main/community/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] I understand this request is public and does not guarantee admission.

The owner reviews requests individually as capacity allows, considering interest in ongoing collaboration, relevant experience, reliability and community principles. Membership does not automatically grant elevated repository permissions. If accepted, an official GitHub invitation will be sent; membership takes effect only after you accept it. You may withdraw the request at any time.
